review_candidates.title: General Manager
review_candidates.description: Job Description – General Manager – Bakery Manufacturing Location: Dubai, UAE Function: Bakery Manufacturing / Operations / NPD Position: General Manager – Bakery Experience: 12–18 years Employment Type: Full-time Role Overview We are looking for an experienced General Manager – Bakery Manufacturing to lead the end-to-end operations of a bakery manufacturing business in Dubai. The ideal candidate should have a strong technical foundation in baking, having started their career as a professional baker or in a hands-on bakery production role, and subsequently progressed into managing large-scale bakery manufacturing operations. The role requires a combination of technical bakery expertise, new product development (NPD), manufacturing leadership, operational excellence, and commercial understanding. The candidate will be responsible for overseeing the entire manufacturing function while driving product innovation, developing new bakery products, improving production efficiencies, and ensuring consistent product quality and profitability. Key Responsibilities 1. Bakery Manufacturing & Operations Lead end-to-end bakery manufacturing operations, including production planning, execution, quality, and dispatch. Oversee the production of a wide range of bakery products, including breads, buns, cakes, pastries, croissants, cookies, and other baked goods. Apply strong technical knowledge of baking processes, recipes, ingredients, dough preparation, fermentation, proofing, baking techniques, and finishing. Drive production efficiency, capacity utilisation, yield optimisation, and cost control. Ensure consistent product quality, food safety, hygiene, and compliance with relevant UAE regulations. Manage production teams, including bakers, supervisors, technicians, and factory personnel. Implement standard operating procedures, production controls, and continuous improvement initiatives. Oversee raw material planning, inventory management, procurement coordination, and wastage reduction. Drive automation, process improvements, and operational scalability. Manage factory budgets, operational KPIs, and overall manufacturing performance. 2. New Product Development (NPD) & Innovation Lead the end-to-end New Product Development process, from concept creation and recipe development to product trials, commercialisation, and full-scale production. Develop innovative bakery products across categories such as breads, buns, cakes, pastries, croissants, cookies, and speciality baked goods. Drive product innovation in line with evolving consumer preferences, market trends, and customer requirements. Lead recipe formulation, ingredient selection, and optimisation of product taste, texture, appearance, and shelf life. Conduct product trials, pilot runs, and production testing to ensure successful transition from development to large-scale manufacturing. Collaborate with R&D, Quality, Procurement, and Commercial teams to assess ingredient suitability, product costing, and manufacturing feasibility. Drive product reformulation initiatives to improve quality, nutritional profiles, shelf life, and cost efficiency. Establish standard recipes, product specifications, process parameters, and quality benchmarks. Identify opportunities to introduce new product categories, premium offerings, and customised bakery solutions for B2B and retail customers. Monitor market trends, competitor offerings, and emerging bakery technologies to drive continuous product innovation. 3. Quality & Food Safety Ensure adherence to food safety, hygiene, and quality management standards. Implement and maintain HACCP, ISO 22000, and other relevant food safety systems. Establish quality control processes across raw materials, production, packaging, and finished products. Ensure consistency in product quality, taste, texture, appearance, and shelf life. Drive corrective and preventive actions to minimise product defects, customer complaints, and production wastage. 4. People & Business Management Lead, mentor, and develop bakery production, NPD, and factory teams. Build a performance-driven culture focused on quality, innovation, productivity, and accountability. Work closely with sales and commercial teams to align production capacity with customer demand. Manage operational budgets, manufacturing costs, and overall business performance. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency and profitability. Candidate Profile 13–18 years of experience in bakery operations and manufacturing, preferably with substantial experience in large-scale bakery production. Must have started their career as a professional baker or bakery production specialist, with genuine hands-on baking experience. Should have progressed into senior manufacturing, factory, or operations leadership roles. Strong technical knowledge of bakery products, production processes, ingredients, recipes, and industrial baking equipment. Demonstrated experience in managing end-to-end bakery manufacturing operations. Hands-on exposure to bakery NPD, recipe formulation, product innovation, product trials, and commercialisation. Experience in scaling new product concepts from kitchen or pilot-level trials to industrial manufacturing. Strong understanding of bakery ingredients, functionality, substitutions, and their impact on finished products. Experience managing large production teams and driving operational efficiencies. Knowledge of food safety standards, with understanding ofrelevant UAE requirements. Experience in the UAE or GCC bakery/food manufacturing industry would be an advantage. Ideal Candidate Profile The ideal candidate would be someone who has: Started their career as a Baker / Master Baker / Bakery Chef. Progressed into Bakery Production Management and Manufacturing Leadership. Gained hands-on experience in NPD, recipe development, and product commercialisation. Managed large-scale bakery manufacturing facilities.

review_candidates.title: ERP Process Engineer
review_candidates.description: Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability At Hypersonica , we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast. By joining Hypersonica , you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously. We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence. What You'll Do Own the company-wide implementation and operation of SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Public Edition , from fit-to-standard design and configuration through testing, migration, deployment, adoption, and continuous improvement. Define the future-state business processes that will underpin Hypersonica’s operations across finance, procurement, supplier management, inventory, warehousing, manufacturing, quality, maintenance, sales, and logistics. Act as the single point of accountability for the SAP programme, owning the roadmap, delivery plan, implementation partners, critical decisions, dependencies, risks, and business readiness. Translate complex and often incomplete operational requirements into scalable, standardised SAP processes that support speed, traceability, and production readiness. Build the master data, governance, access, approval, and reporting structures required to make SAP the company’s operational source of truth. Own the implementation of serial and batch traceability, production orders, inventory control, quality records, procurement workflows, and other controls required for high-consequence hardware manufacturing. Lead system integration between SAP and Hypersonica’s wider technology environment, including engineering, manufacturing, HR, CRM, reporting, identity, document management, and other business-critical platforms. Own the rollout and optimisation of associated SAP products, including SAP Sales Cloud and SAP SuccessFactors, where they support the wider business systems architecture. Establish the SAP operating model, including process owners, super users, training, support, release management, regression testing, issue escalation, and continuous improvement. Drive adoption across the business, ensuring teams use the system correctly and that parallel spreadsheets, disconnected workflows, and unofficial sources of truth are removed. Build clear programme and systems reporting for leadership, including implementation progress, adoption, data quality, risks, control gaps, and business outcomes. Select and manage implementation partners and software vendors, ensuring they deliver against Hypersonica’s pace, quality bar, and operational requirements. Ensure business systems remain secure, controlled, audit-ready, and aligned with relevant quality, financial, security, and regulatory expectations. Who You Are A senior SAP or enterprise systems leader with a proven record of implementing SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Public Edition across a complex physical-product business. You have led a major ERP implementation end to end, not simply supported one module or maintained an already mature system. Experienced across multiple operational domains, ideally including manufacturing, procurement, inventory, warehousing, finance, quality, maintenance, and supply chain. Strong in business process design and able to turn fragmented company practices into coherent, scalable operating processes. Deeply familiar with fit-to-standard implementation and confident challenging executives and functional leaders when unnecessary customisation creates long-term risk. Comfortable owning implementation partners, programme plans, budgets, dependencies, data migration, testing, training, cutover, and business adoption. Able to operate credibly with both senior leadership and functional users, translating between operational needs, system architecture, and implementation reality. Technically literate across integrations, APIs, identity and access, master data, permissions, reporting, and business application architecture. What We Offer A mission-driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security. Daily collaboration with leading experts across engineering, operations, business development, and defence, with genuine opportunities to learn, contribute, and grow. Exposure to the full lifecycle of complex defence programmes, from customer requirements and commercial strategy through to engineering delivery and flight testing. High ownership and autonomy: no time tracking and no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes. A fast-paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly and feedback from testing and flight drives real decisions. A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly. Competitive compensation and real share options aligned with responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy. At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply. Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential. You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

review_candidates.description: Company Description Maxicare Health Services, Inc. (MHSI) is a subsidiary of Maxicare Healthcare Corporation, established in 2021 to provide quality and accessible medical services to Maxicare clients. The company currently operates 19 Maxicare Primary Care Clinics and several on-site corporate clinics across various industries. As a proud member of the Equicom Group, MHSI benefits from a diversified network in information technology, banking, financial services, and healthcare. MHSI is committed to helping clients live their best lives through preventive, primary, and specialty care, supported by state-of-the-art laboratory and diagnostic services across its clinic network. Applicants joining MHSI become part of a mission-driven organization focused on superior medical services and patient-centered care. Role Description The Commercial Planning Manager is a full-time role based in Makati with a hybrid work arrangement, combining on-site collaboration and some work-from-home flexibility. This role is responsible for leading commercial and business planning activities, including the development of annual and long-range plans aligned with Maxicare Health Services, Inc.’s growth and profitability objectives. The Commercial Planning Manager will analyze market trends, client demand, and internal performance data to build robust demand forecasts and optimize clinic capacity and service offerings. Day-to-day responsibilities include tracking and interpreting key performance indicators, preparing regular commercial performance reports and dashboards, and providing insights and recommendations to senior management. The role also involves partnering with operations, finance, marketing, and clinic leaders to support commercial initiatives, refine pricing and service mix strategies, and ensure consistent execution of commercial plans across the clinic network. Qualifications Strong commercial and business planning capabilities, including experience in Commercial Planning and Business Planning. Proficiency in Demand Planning with the ability to forecast volumes, capacity, and resource needs in a healthcare or service environment. Advanced Analytical Skills, including data interpretation, scenario modeling, and use of spreadsheets or business intelligence tools. Experience in defining, monitoring, and improving Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for commercial, operational, and financial performance. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Management, or a related field; advanced degree or professional certification is an advantage. Background in healthcare, clinic operations, or service-oriented industries is highly beneficial. Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams and communicate insights clearly to non-technical audiences. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong attention to detail and a structured, organized approach to work. Comfort working in a hybrid setup based in Makati, with flexibility to attend on-site meetings and coordinate with clinic and corporate teams as needed.
